_comment: OSA scheduled jobs — copy to ~/.osa/CRONS.json. Every job needs: name, schedule (standard 5-field cron: min hour day-of-month month day-of-week), type, and enabled. 'type' is one of: 'agent' (needs a 'job' string — a task run through the agent loop), 'command' (needs a 'command' string — a shell command with the same safety checks as the shell_execute tool), or 'webhook' (needs a 'url'; optional 'method' [default GET], 'headers', and on failure 'on_failure':'agent' + 'failure_job' to hand off to the agent). 'id' is optional (auto-generated if omitted) but recommended. A job that fails 3 times in a row is auto-disabled (circuit breaker) until you re-enable it.

jobs.name: Morning Briefing
jobs.job: Generate my morning briefing: weather, calendar summary, top 3 news items, and today's priorities. Save to ~/.osa/briefings/today.md

jobs.name: Weekly Summary
jobs.job: Generate a weekly summary: tasks completed, key metrics, and priorities for next week. Save to ~/.osa/reports/weekly.md

jobs.name: Service Health Check
jobs.failure_job: The health check for localhost:8080 failed. Investigate the likely cause and write a short note to ~/.osa/alerts/health.md
